# Separate kernels over infection an sex

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(adehabitatHR)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(terra)
library(ggspatial)
library(RColorBrewer)

source(here::here("R","trip_functions.R"))
source(here::here("R","problem_trips.R"))

load(here("data","NewlyCreatedData","clean_6_locs_AD_rouzic23.Rdata"))

ext.brit<-terra::ext(300000,650000,5270000,5650000)

#filter and project clean trips
locs<-loc.clean.interp.rouzic %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(sero=as.factor(sero),
                  sex=as.factor(sex),
                  deploy=as.factor(deploy)) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!trip.id %in% migration & 
                      !trip.id %in% last.incomplete) %>% 
    sf::st_as_sf(., coords = c("long","lat")) %>% 
    sf::st_set_crs(4326) %>% 
    st_transform(., projcrs) %>% 
    as_Spatial(.)
rm(loc.clean.interp.rouzic)

#load bathymetry layer
bathym<-terra::rast(here::here("data",
                               "RawData",
                               "shapefiles",
                               "Bathym_FR_UK.tif")) %>% 
       terra::project(.,projcrs) %>% 
       terra::crop(., ext.brit)

bathym[bathym>0]<-0
ocean.pal <- rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"Blues"))(9))
zbreaks <- c(-500,-200,-150,-100,-50,-25,0)


#select borders
target<-c("France","United Kingdom","Spain","Belgium",
          "Netherlands", "Germany","Ireland","Isle of Man",
          "Jersey" ,"Guernsey"  ,"Åland")


#contours of countries
shp<-ne_countries(scale = 10, returnclass = 'sf') %>%
    dplyr::filter(name %in% target) %>% 
  st_transform(.,projcrs)  %>% 
    st_crop(., ext.brit)

#coastlines
coast<-ne_coastline(scale = 10, returnclass = "sf") %>% 
  st_transform(.,projcrs)  %>% 
    st_crop(., ext.brit)

coord_rouzic<-colo_coord_rouzic %>% 
    sf::st_as_sf(., coords = c("long","lat")) %>% 
    sf::st_set_crs(4326)


##kernels pour les sero
KUD.sero<- kernelUD(locs[,"sero"],
                    same4all=T,
                    h=10000,
                    grid=1000)
KUDvol.sero <- getvolumeUD(KUD.sero)
ver90.sero<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sero ,90) %>% 
    st_as_sf(.)
# ver75.sero<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sero ,75)%>% 
#     st_as_sf(.)
ver50.sero<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sero ,50)%>% 
    st_as_sf(.)
# ver25.sero<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sero ,25)%>% 
#     st_as_sf(.)

kern.sero<-ggplot()+
   # tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = bathym, aes(fill =  Bathym_FR_UK)) +
    geom_sf(data=ver90.sero, fill=c("yellow","orchid"),
                             colour=c("yellow","orchid"),
                             alpha=0.5) +
 #   geom_sf(data=ver75.sero, aes(fill=c(col[3],col[4]), alpha=0.3)) +
    geom_sf(data=ver50.sero, fill=c("yellow4","darkorchid4"),
                             colour=c("yellow4","darkorchid4"),
                             alpha=0.5) +
 #   geom_sf(data=ver25.sero,  aes(fill=c(col[7],col[8]), alpha=0.3)) + 
    geom_sf(data=shp,fill="grey90") +
    geom_sf(data=coast) +
    geom_sf(data = coord_rouzic,
            shape=23, 
            colour="black",
            fill="yellow", 
            size=4) + 
    labs(title="Distribution infected vs unfected") +
    coord_sf(xlim=ext.brit[c(1,2)],
             ylim=ext.brit[c(3,4)],
             expand=F) +

    # scale_fill_gradientn(name="Bathymétrie",
    #                      colors =ocean.pal,
    #                      limits = c(- 200, 0))+
    annotation_scale(location = "br",
                     width_hint = 0.15,
                     pad_x = unit(0.7, "cm"),
                     bar_cols = "black") +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "br",
                           which_north = "true",
                           style = ggspatial::north_arrow_nautical(),
                           pad_y = unit(0.8, "cm")) +
    theme_bw() 

print(kern.sero)


##kernels for sex

KUD.sex<- kernelUD(locs[,"sex"],
                    same4all=T,
                    h=10000,
                    grid=1000)
KUDvol.sex <- getvolumeUD(KUD.sex)
ver90.sex<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sex ,90) %>% 
    st_as_sf(.)
# ver75.sex<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sex ,75)%>% 
#     st_as_sf(.)
ver50.sex<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sex ,50)%>% 
    st_as_sf(.)
# ver25.sex<-getverticeshr(KUDvol.sex ,25)%>% 
#     st_as_sf(.)



  kern.sex<-ggplot()+
   # tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = bathym, aes(fill =  Bathym_FR_UK)) +
    geom_sf(data=ver90.sex, fill=c("yellow","orchid"),
                             colour=c("yellow","orchid"),
                             alpha=0.5) +
 #   geom_sf(data=ver75.sex, aes(fill=c(col[3],col[4]), alpha=0.3)) +
    geom_sf(data=ver50.sex, fill=c("yellow4","darkorchid4"),
                             colour=c("yellow4","darkorchid4"),
                             alpha=0.5) +
 #   geom_sf(data=ver25.sex,  aes(fill=c(col[7],col[8]), alpha=0.3)) + 
    geom_sf(data=shp,fill="grey90") +
    geom_sf(data=coast) +
    geom_sf(data = coord_rouzic,
            shape=23, 
            colour="black",
            fill="yellow", 
            size=4) + 
    coord_sf(xlim=ext.brit[c(1,2)],
             ylim=ext.brit[c(3,4)],
             expand=F) +
  labs(title="Distribution males vs females") +
    # scale_fill_gradientn(name="Bathymétrie",
    #                      colors =ocean.pal,
    #                      limits = c(- 200, 0))+
    annotation_scale(location = "br",
                     width_hint = 0.15,
                     pad_x = unit(0.7, "cm"),
                     bar_cols = "black") +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "br",
                           which_north = "true",
                           style = ggspatial::north_arrow_nautical(),
                           pad_y = unit(0.8, "cm")) +
    theme_bw() 

print(kern.sex)
```

# GIF animation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(gganimate)

#define an extent for study area
    xmin<-240000
    xmax<-830000
    ymin<-5190000
    ymax<-5620000



loc_df<-as.data.frame(locs) %>%
    dplyr::rename(long=coords.x1,
            lat=coords.x2)
    # dplyr::filter(id=="233659"| id=="235197")

nb<-length(unique(loc_df$id))

#contours of countries
shp<-ne_countries(scale = 10, returnclass = 'sf') %>%
    dplyr::filter(name %in% target) %>%
  st_transform(.,projcrs)  %>%
    st_crop(., ext(c(xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax)))

#coastlines
coast<-ne_coastline(scale = 10, returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_transform(.,projcrs) %>%
    st_crop(., ext(c(xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax)))


anim <- ggplot()+

  # basemap
  geom_sf(data = shp)+
     geom_sf(data = coast)+

  coord_sf(xlim=c(xmin,xmax),
             ylim=c(ymin,ymax),
             expand=F) +
  # lines and points
  geom_path(data = loc_df,
            aes(x=long,y=lat,
                group=id,
                color=id),
                 show.legend = FALSE,
            alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(data = loc_df,
             aes(x=long,y=lat,
                 group=id,
                 fill=id),
             show.legend = FALSE,
             alpha = 0.7,
             shape=21,
             size = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=magma(nb)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values=magma(nb)) +

  # formatting
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL,
       fill = 'Sex',
       color = 'Sex')+
  theme_minimal()+
    annotation_scale(location = "br",
                     width_hint = 0.15,
                     pad_x = unit(0.7, "cm"),
                     bar_cols = "black") +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "br",
                           which_north = "true",
                           style = ggspatial::north_arrow_nautical(),
                           pad_y = unit(0.8, "cm")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(anim)


animgif = anim +
  transition_reveal(along = datetime) +
#  ease_aes('linear') +
  ggtitle("Date:{frame_along}")

gganimate::animate(animgif, nframes = 800, fps = 25,
                   renderer = gifski_renderer(),
                   height=8,
                   width=4,
                   res=400,
                   units="in")
gganimate::anim_save(here::here("outputs","tracks.gif"))
```
